# The Fix Wizard

> Licensed and insured chimney repair, masonry, and handyman services serving South Jersey, Greater Philadelphia, and the Delaware Valley.

The Fix Wizard is a home repair company based in Cherry Hill, NJ. We specialize in two core service lines: Chimney & Masonry repair and general Handyman Services. Same-day appointments available. Free estimates. Licensed and insured.

## Contact & Business Info

- Phone: (551) 350-4951
- Email: office@thefixwizard.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7am–7pm
- Home Base: Cherry Hill, NJ (Camden County)
- License: Licensed & insured in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Delaware

## Service Areas

We serve 14 specific communities in South Jersey, Greater Philadelphia, and Wilmington:

**New Jersey:** Cherry Hill, Haddonfield, Voorhees, Marlton, Moorestown, Mount Laurel, Trenton, Princeton, Atlantic City

**Pennsylvania:** Philadelphia, Wayne, King of Prussia, West Chester

**Delaware:** Wilmington

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is The Fix Wizard licensed and insured?**
A: Yes. The Fix Wizard is fully licensed and insured in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Delaware for all services offered. We carry liability insurance on every job and all technicians are background-checked.

**Q: Do you offer same-day service?**
A: Yes. We offer same-day appointments across South Jersey and Greater Philadelphia. Call (551) 350-4951 for urgent requests.

**Q: Do you offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. All estimates are free with no obligation.

**Q: How much does chimney repair cost?**
A: Chimney sweeping and inspection typically costs $150–$300. Tuckpointing ranges from $500–$3,000 depending on the extent of mortar deterioration. Crown repair runs $200–$800. Chimney liner installation starts around $1,500. Full chimney rebuilds start at $2,500.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: Cherry Hill, Haddonfield, Voorhees, Marlton, Moorestown, Mount Laurel (NJ), Philadelphia, Wayne, King of Prussia, West Chester (PA), Wilmington (DE), Trenton, Princeton, Atlantic City (NJ).

**Q: What handyman jobs can be combined in one visit?**
A: Many — drywall patching, painting touch-ups, outlet replacement, faucet repair, furniture assembly, and TV mounting are commonly combined in a single appointment.
